body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, learn its remaining Reaction Dice and lowest Defense. You gain +1 Harmony against it until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Share the defensive benefit with one willing ally within 3 units.
On a hit, impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, bind the target. Trigger: it declares an Action with at least 3 rolled dice. Echo: yourself or a willing ally within 3 units may move 1 unit before its roll.
